_doc: M14 (Nov 9, Duff: 'the dialogue for each strip is too similar'). Every knockout gets its own device instead of the shared He's-X-I'm-Y / The-human-N-bones / Dolores-honey shape. Lines that already landed are left out of this file (unchanged). Apply: python3 tools/apply_ko_rewrites.py

husk.stance: Two hundred million people are watching his stream. Hector from the dish pit is watching mine. Hector isn't even watching. He's eating my fries.
husk.slip: Rocket punch. Slow. Everything's slow after a double. I lean six inches left. The chat spams laughing faces. For once, the chat is right.
husk.xray: The jaw is the only bone in the skull that moves. My elbow shows it somewhere new to go.
husk.crowd: Brittany: "Viewers are dropping, Duff! Two hundred million. Forty million. Okay, it's mostly bots now."
husk.closer: Stream ended. Viewers: zero. I fix my apron. Somewhere a market dips. Nobody I know owns any of it.

bozos.stance: Order status: out for delivery. The package is me. He owns seventeen houses. I own a bus pass and a cat who thinks I'm staff.
bozos.slip: Drones. A whole fleet. I duck the first. The second hits the third. The fourth starts talking about a union.
bozos.xray: Two hinges hold a jaw on. His were assembled overseas. My knee comes up from below, and both hinges quit on the same shift.
bozos.crowd: Dolores: "Return to sender. No refunds. Store policy."
bozos.closer: Status: delivered. Left at front door. Signed for by my left hook.

fences.stance: Error: punch not found. He's buffering. I'm not. I tap my chest twice and wait. Patience is free. Everything else, he sells you.
fences.slip: Blue screen. The whole room goes blue. I've rebooted a register at 2 AM with ketchup on both thumbs. This is nothing.
fences.closer: Do you want to save your changes? He doesn't answer. Nobody ever does.

baron.stance: Your shoes have never stood a double. Mine stood four this week. I drop my jacket. I don't look where it lands. Somebody always picks it up for you.
baron.slip: Coins, thirty-seven cents at a time. I catch a quarter out of the air. Pocket it. That's one load of laundry.
baron.xray: Old money lives in the lower back. Three generations of good posture. One kidney shot and every generation bows.

donald.stance: He's talking. Six minutes now. No commas. I wait for one. I'm still waiting. I step in on a vowel.
donald.slip: A wall goes up. Big. Beautiful. Somebody else paid for it. I walk around the end. Every wall has an end.
donald.crowd: Dolores: "First time all night that man stopped talking. Somebody frame it."
donald.closer: He calls it a landslide. Best loss in history. I call it Tuesday and clock back in.

ghoster.stance: 11:52 PM, three years ago: he leaves {partner} on read. 11:52 PM, tonight: he's left standing. I hold my hands low. I let him guess.
ghoster.closer: Typing... Typing... Nothing. Some guys never learn to hit send.

djvape.stance: A hundred and twenty-eight beats a minute. My fillings hum along. Everybody in here is waiting for the drop. So am I. Mine's just different.

willnot.stance: Floor forty. No shoes. Glass everywhere. He's bleeding and still monologuing. I slide my feet like the floor's just been mopped.
willnot.slip: Sprinklers. Vents. A fire axe. Bad attitude. He throws all of it. I go low, then lower, then I'm behind him, like a server sneaking a plate out of the window.
willnot.xray: Twenty-six bones in each foot, and he walked across broken glass on all of them. I'm not cruel. I aim higher. The jaw goes up. So does he.

sendback.stance: Ticket. Table nine. Sent back: nine plates. Plate ten: me. No garnish. No substitutions.
sendback.xray: Ten thousand taste buds, give or take. His have only ever tasted complaints. One uppercut and he tries something new. Humility. Medium rare.

coupon.crowd: Brittany: "She's got a coupon for the ambulance. Duff. She has a coupon for the AMBULANCE."

allergy.crowd: Dolores: "Booth four. A whole basket of rolls. I counted."

camper.stance: His laptop: three percent. My patience: two. Four hours in booth six on one coffee. I go stand where the outlet is.
camper.xray: Four hours in a booth shortens the hip flexors by about the length of a grudge. One knee to the hip and his snap like a gas-station charging cable.

dasher.xray: Running away takes about two hundred muscles. Stopping takes one. It's mine.
